title: Maximum Split of Positive Even Integers
goal: Split an even total into as many distinct positive even values as possible.
strategy: Choose the smallest unused even values while they fit. Any leftover even amount is smaller than the next candidate, so adding it to the last chosen value preserves distinctness without reducing the count.
